scientific_question: Does the local six-mode generator spectrum remain numerically consistent when the same full native state is expressed through invertible coordinate changes that preserve all six state dimensions?
equilibrium_source: the exactly one accepted positive root already frozen in the immutable v0.3 artifact for each case; no root solving is rerun

comparison.matching: exhaustive minimum-total-complex-distance assignment over all 6! permutations, using physical_x as reference at the same finite-difference multiplier
report: all six eigenvalues for every representation and multiplier
spectral abscissa for every representation and multiplier
all-mode assignment and total complex distance to physical_x
per-mode absolute and relative complex difference from physical_x
comparison.relative_difference: absolute complex difference divided by absolute physical_x reference eigenvalue when nonzero, otherwise null

interpretation_rule: Agreement across these invertible full-state coordinates is only a necessary numerical sanity check. Because local Jacobians under smooth invertible full-state coordinate changes are theoretically related by similarity at an equilibrium, this control cannot by itself establish biological representation independence, identifiability, observability, or scalar adequacy.
